brief: Restrained, warm, close-up object sounds that confirm what the child just did, plus a calm night ambience beneath speech. No cartoon boings, no buzzers or negative sounds for mistakes, no music competing with Pip and Bear.

tile-place.trigger: letter placed in a word space
tile-place.prompt: a small smooth wooden letter tile placed onto a wooden tray, one soft click, close, dry, no reverb

tile-lift.prompt: a small wooden tile gently lifted off a wooden tray, one light soft tick, close, dry

apple-basket.prompt: one apple gently dropped into a wicker picnic basket, soft thud with a light wicker creak, close, dry

apple-lift.trigger: apple taken out of basket or off a plate
apple-lift.prompt: one apple lifted out of a wicker basket, soft brief wicker rustle, close, gentle

apple-plate.trigger: apple placed on a friend's plate
apple-plate.prompt: one apple placed gently on a ceramic plate, soft muted clink, close, dry

reveal.trigger: word completed and its object appears
reveal.prompt: an old paper map unfolding, ending in a soft warm shimmer of tiny bells, gentle, magical, quiet

success.prompt: gentle warm three-note rising marimba chime, soft and cheerful, for young children, short, no long tail

sparkle.prompt: tiny soft twinkling sparkle like small glass bells, gentle, brief

paper-turn.prompt: a single soft sheet of paper being turned, gentle, close, dry

whoosh.prompt: a soft airy gentle whoosh, like a light warm breeze, quiet, brief

ending.prompt: little lanterns lighting up one by one, soft twinkling glockenspiel notes and gentle shimmer, calm, warm, magical, quiet

ambience.trigger: loops quietly during the picnic, ducked under speech
ambience.prompt: continuous calm night ambience: soft crickets chirping evenly through the whole clip at one constant volume, faint gentle breeze, seamless loop, no fade in, no fade out, no owls, no birds, no sudden or loud sounds, no music, no voices
ambience.note: Take 1 (with occasional owl and breeze) was a little distracting for the parent; take 2 asks for a steady, even bed and is levelled 6 dB lower.
